name: entscheidsuche
title: entscheidsuche-mcp
description: MCP server for Swiss court decisions and case law provided by entscheidsuche.ch. Full-text search over decisions of the Federal Supreme Court (BGer, BGE) and cantonal courts in German, French and Italian.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Swiss case law
tools.description: Full-text search across Swiss court decisions and case law.

tools.name: search_by_case_number
tools.title: Search by case number
tools.description: Exact lookup of Swiss case numbers, docket references and BGE citations.

tools.name: fetch_document
tools.title: Fetch document
tools.description: Retrieve a single decision together with its full text.

tools.name: list_hierarchy
tools.title: List court hierarchy
tools.description: List cantons, courts and chambers with counts.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.title: List facets
tools.description: Localized facet tree for courts and jurisdictions.

tools.name: server_info
tools.title: Server information
tools.description: Version and endpoint information for this server.
